settings.title: The Qutb Shahi city
settings.text: Founded by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah, with the Charminar at its heart.

settings.title: The attar lanes
settings.text: Around the Charminar, fragrance has been blended and sold for generations.

settings.title: Ivory and gold
settings.text: Hyderabad's pearl trade gave the city its lustre, and this house its palette.

settings.label: In Persian
settings.text: Agha means lord, master or gentleman. It was used to address people of high status, such as noblemen and respected elders.

settings.label: In Ottoman times
settings.text: It named senior officials and military leaders, such as the Janissary Agha who commanded the elite troops.

settings.label: Across the region
settings.text: In many Middle Eastern and South Asian societies it is a term of respect for elders, teachers and community leaders.

settings.label: Today
settings.text: It is still a respectful address in Iran, Turkey, Afghanistan and parts of India, often joined to a first or last name.
